Factor operator T_1999 into low-rank projection U_1999 * S_1999 * V_1999^T.
Apply lemma L_circuit_bounds: rewrite Phi_circuit_bounds(T_1999(x)) into Phi_circuit_bounds(x) + delta_1999.
Prove delta_1999 vanishes identically via orthogonality constraints.
By mathematical induction over depth k_1999, the claim holds universally. Q.E.D.
